critique: The piece achieves a brilliant Dadaist punk-zine aesthetic, utilizing CSS blend modes to seamlessly layer distressed paper grain, halftone patterns, and chaotic ransom-note typography into a highly tactile composition. However, the rigidly mathematical flight paths and uniform flapping of the canvas bats feel too cleanly digital; introducing frame-rate jitter or ragged, hand-drawn vector edges to their wings would better anchor them within the analog grunge.
